item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 02/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. It will be windy over the region. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, the weather will be generally fine and dry over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early next week. A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and southern parts of the South China Sea early to midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Krathon will track northwards. It will move across Taiwan on Thursday and weaken gradually, then move towards the vicinity of the East China Sea.
